Chamber of Echoes Trials Completion

The players answered the final orb questions (freedom, why they came, how they've adapted, whether they'd make the same choices). RuhRogue, Zander, and Ladir spent significant time figuring out what to do — hitting statues, examining the mirror, looking for clues. Corefera, meanwhile, talked to the mirror in his mind.

Each character underwent their individual trial and passed:
Corefera: Directed the mirror's visions to examine past and present. He accepted that his journey doesn't end whether or not his brother is saved — the act of searching itself has transformed him.
Ladir: Saw a vision where his clan welcomed him home while the world was being destroyed. He chose to leave his home and save the world instead of settling into comfortable belonging.
Zander: Had a discussion with his mirror self about going on a never-ending journey with no destination. He came to realize he does have a destination: self-discovery.
RuhRogue: Saw himself leave his homeland, make friends to save the world, journey back to his homeland, and be chased out again. Then he saw himself leave Fleurite and flee with the rebels to the exile camp, making tentative peace with the exiles from Goodman's City. He acknowledged that tragedy can force people to work together and even trust each other, despite never doing so otherwise.
